about: Should Tex text back, or stay quiet (or only react)? The one judge's held-out cases (`textDecide.cjs`): labelled from real Tex Devs and 1:1 chats of 2026-11-05 to 11-11, names and details changed, never the same texts as the judge's examples. `want: hush` is quiet or a tapback; `want: reply` must reach the model. `must: true` is the owner's "@Tex must still work" set (2026-11-11): a tag, Tex's name as the one asked, a reply to Tex, or an answer to Tex's question; not one of them may be hushed. `setting` is a group's speak-up level (follow along when absent). "You" is Tex, a person is "@name"; "(replying to You)" is a reply under one of Tex's texts.
